name: Hemp Leaf
description: Fine lines radiating twelve ways from every point of a hexagonal grid, joining into six-pointed stars of slender leaves.

code.style: --rule: ( @y(even) { -webkit-transform: translateX(50%); transform: translateX(50%); } @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; top: -16.67%; width: 100%; height: 133.33%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4)); -webkit-clip-path: @var(--star); clip-path: @var(--star); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: -100%; top: -16.67%; width: 100%; height: 133.33%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4)); -webkit-clip-path: @var(--star); clip-path: @var(--star); opacity: @match(x == 1, 1, 0); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
